import json, collections
def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line color: value whose full rows/cols exist (other than bg)
    line=next(v for v in set(sum(g,[])) if v!=bg and any(all(x==v for x in r) for r in g))
    lr=[i for i in range(H) if all(x==line for x in g[i])]
    lc=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==line for i in range(H))]
    br=[-1]+[b+1 for b in (lr+[H])]; bc=[-1]+[b+1 for b in (lc+[W])]
    regs=list(zip(br,br[1:]))+[] 
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r0,r1 in zip(br,br[1:]):
        for c0,c1 in zip(bc,bc[1:]):

            sub=[g[i][j] for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1)]
            n=sum(1 for x in sub if x!=bg and x!=line)
            if n>=2:
                for i in range(r0,r1):
                    for j in range(c0,c1):
                        res[i][j]=n
    return res

    cb=sorted([-1]+lc+[W])
    for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]):
        for c,d in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
